overview: QRNova is a free, no-account QR code generator that creates, customizes and downloads scannable QR codes for 13 content categories entirely in the browser.
features: Generate QR codes for URLs, text, Wi-Fi, email, phone, SMS, WhatsApp, contacts, locations, social media, PDF links, events and app downloads
Customize colors, palettes, gradients, dot and corner styles, center logo, size and padding with live preview
Download QR codes as PNG, JPG and high-resolution print PNG
Premium futuristic homepage with category grid, how-it-works, FAQ and educational content
SEO-ready pages with unique titles, meta descriptions, breadcrumbs and structured data
